description: The verdict chain for one charity, link by link (L0 Defined to L7 Checked), read out only from data we already hold: the evidence-gap ledger, our outcome ledger, the evaluator figures we hold and the verdict procedure (https://diditwork.org/agents/verdict-procedure.json). Returns record in the procedure's output_record shape: links (id, name, question, answer, rung from the procedure's ladder or null for L0/L7, evaluator_label_verbatim, source, open_question), weakest_link (the procedure's rule), open_questions and summary_donor_voice; plus rung_rules (how each rung follows from existing grades), widest_evidence_gap (the ledger's own binding gap), better_source and covered. Computes nothing: every figure and date is copied whole from a stored value, and the response holds no JSON number. No overall verdict, score, grade or count of strong links: live charities get no worked/didn't-work word. Charities without an evidence-gap entry get covered: false and every link 'Not covered' with a pointer to get_org and the evaluator. Same function as GET /v1/verdict-chain/{org_id}.
name: verdict_chain
title: Verdict chain
